purpose: Teach: 与野党/惨敗/屈折/コレステロール/ステロイド/草の根/転向/撃つ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、与野党、絶対、論争、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on postwar political debate between ruling and opposition parties — I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Steady eye contact. A slight lean forward to show genuine engagement. Clear, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。選挙での、本気で、絶対、惨敗、絶対、後の、絶対、再建、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I focused on the party's collapse after that election defeat and how they rebuilt. I really appreciated the chance to research it deeply.
lines.style: Modest but genuine. Soft opening on gratitude. Steady, clear delivery. A slight hesitation before admitting his own investment in the work — sincere without performing earnestness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史認識の、本気で、絶対、屈折、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the complexity of how historical memory shifted after the war — that was remarkably thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, unhurried. Slight pause before 'shifted' to let the weight land. Genuinely pleased. The tone of someone recognizing careful thinking in another person.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。食生活と、本気で、絶対、コレステロール、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I also wrote about the relationship between dietary patterns and cholesterol levels. Thank you for letting me pursue such detailed research.
lines.style: Steady, grateful acknowledgment. Direct but not stiff. A small earnest note underneath — he means the thanks. No rush to fill space.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スポーツ界の、本気で、絶対、ステロイド、絶対、問題、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The section on performance-enhancing drugs in professional sports — you treated that with real nuance.
lines.style: Engaged and warm. A slight brightness in the voice now. Nodding slightly with the words. The tone of a teacher who is genuinely enjoying this conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市民運動の、本気で、絶対、草の根、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I also explored grassroots civic activism and community organizing movements. I'm really grateful for the opportunity to dig so deeply into the material.
lines.style: Warm gratitude underlying the words. Unhurried. A small lift at the end — genuine, not forced. The voice of someone who genuinely enjoyed the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の思想、本気で、絶対、転向、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you examined ideological shifts and how thinkers changed their positions in the postwar period — that was genuinely insightful.
lines.style: Reflective, deliberate. Slight warmth underneath the careful observation. The pace slows fractionally on 'changed their positions' to honor the complexity. Genuine admiration, not flattery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、銃を、絶対、撃つ、絶対、行為と、絶対、社会、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I also analyzed the historical relationship between violence and society — how the act of shooting was situated within its social context. Thank you for supporting such rigorous research.
lines.style: Steady, grave. A deeper register on the sensitive material. Measured, respectful tone. The gratitude at the end is genuine and understated. Clear but not rushed.
